name: Sheba Jamal

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sheba Jamal writes in English and Hindi. Literary Vibes published several of her poems in its June 2023 edition, including “Scars”, “Dear Departed” and “Slumbered Passion”. Its author note also records her work as an English teacher in Patna, matching the contributor biography held by Kabita Live.

“INVISIBLE SCARS”, her poem in Kabita Live, explores wounds that remain after visible injuries have healed. Harsh speech becomes a scorpion’s sting, while broken affection appears as an unstrung chain of beads. The closing reference to honour killing turns this language of hurt into a protest against violence within the family. A version appears as “Scars” in Literary Vibes.
